exposure: Gut microbiota composition (Proteobacteria-dominant cluster, Firmicutes-dominant cluster, Bacteroidetes-dominant cluster) at 4 and 12 months of age
outcome: Neurodevelopmental outcomes (cognitive, language, motor development) measured by Bayley Scale of Infant Development (BSID-III) at 1 and 2 years of age
cohort: The study included 405 infants (199 females) from the Canadian Healthy Infant Longitudinal Development (CHILD) Cohort Study.
finding: The Bacteroidetes-dominant gut microbiota cluster at 12 months of age was positively associated with enhanced cognitive, language, and motor development scores at age 2, particularly in male infants.
